3,082 likes, 90 comments - mirzasaniar on October 22, 2026: "One thing tennis has taught me is that no two players learn the same way. 

Some need a little push. Some need a small cue. And sometimes, the best thing a coach can do is let them figure it out themselves.

I believe the same goes for learning math.

That’s what I love about @cuemath . Every child gets a dedicated 1:1 math coach who understands how they learn and helps them become confident, independent thinkers.

Because the right coaching can make all the difference. 

Visit cuemath.com

#Cuemath #MathFit #PersonalizedLearning #Saniamirza".
